Factions.Faction: The Imber Corporation is a large and well established organization, having a presence on many planets and in outer space. They have been criticized for their many territory expansion initiatives, which have forced other smaller colonies from areas they once resided within. They considers all other factions as a potential threat, and aggressively defends their property if provoked.

Ships belonging to Independent Contractors follow no particular style or theme, since the pilots often own and operate these vessels. Contractors can be found on many planets and in outer space. Many of these contractors do not trust other factions and will become defensive if approached.

Parallax Concepts is a mid-sized organization that is established on several planets and in outer space. While they do not have large ambitions to conquer and expand, they don't respond kindly to those that are not affiliated with their faction and will attack if provoked.
Don't let this factions name fool you, they may be neutral but will look poorly upon any would-be pirates.

The Trade Operators Coalition is a collective of trading organizations that have combined their resources and various connections to become one of the dominate economic forces found across several systems.
This faction starts out relatively passive. Leave them alone and they will leave you alone, annoy them repeatedly and they will up their aggressiveness in response.
This faction does not appreciate any intruders to it's territory and will defend it.
